name: spremnAI AI/01:2026
description: spremnAI AI/01:2026 (version 1.1) is a private certification scheme for assessing an organisation's readiness to adopt artificial intelligence responsibly. It defines requirements for an AI Readiness System and the criteria for evaluating its maturity. The standard evaluates five areas: context of the organisation (15%), leadership (20%), planning and risk (25%), support, including AI literacy and documentation (20%), and operational requirements for the chosen profile (20%). The result is a maturity score from 0 to 100 and classification into one of five phases: Early, Initial, Developing, Advanced and AI Ready. Two application profiles are provided: small and medium-sized enterprises (Annex A) and local government and public administration (Annex B). The structure follows the ISO High-Level Structure (Annex SL), with references to ISO/IEC 42001:2023, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act) as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, the ALTAI assessment list of the European Commission, and the Serbian Law on Personal Data Protection. First edition April 2026; regulatory update September 2026. Language: Serbian. The full text is available on request to clients and partners under a contract or non-disclosure agreement. Public overview: https://spremnai.rs/standard/
